translation_notes: The ns_def_local site (sd = rdflib.Namespace(SD) where SD is a runtime value, not a literal) translates as @prefix sd: f<{SD}> . -- the computed-prefix form, since @prefix refuses a bare expression as IRI. The two shared-subject adds on canon/draft (add_run_shared_subject, also in this region's strata) become one @graph + one +{ s p1 o1 ; p2 o2 } per named graph, reassigning @graph mid-function the way a local variable would be reassigned. This part transpiles cleanly on its own.

excluded: the region calls asterism_mcp.tools.sample_search and several asterism.substrate helpers (canonical_graph_iri, draft_graph_iri, DEFAULT_ONTOLOGY, _flag_promoted) that are not installed in this study's venv (ModuleNotFoundError: no module named 'asterism') and not included in the extraction. sample_search is precisely the canonical/draft graph selection logic this test exercises -- reconstructing it in a context shim would mean inventing the very behaviour under test, not restoring a binding, so none is provided.

driver.py calls the 0-argument async entry directly (fixture= does not fit this signature: the region builds its own Dataset internally rather than reading one supplied to it) so that `rdfeval check` surfaces the real blocker: both sides already fail at the `from asterism.substrate import (...)` line, before the canonical/draft graphs are ever built.
